Figma Handoff, Round Two

MoSJE Website DBIM handoff, page "Our Performance — Beneficiary Dashboard", 7 Oct 2026. "Before" was captured from Figma before any edit; "After" is the same frame now. Every screen is editable layers built from SAMAVESH and DBIM library parts. The page has 14 screens in 11 journeys, re-stacked; the guide, page map, change log and the build references are updated.

Dashboard Landing / All India

The four Department sections leave the landing; Department and Portal Dashboards with the Department's card, portal names as titles, two cards a row; the hero lines say what they count; lowest five without bars.

Department of Social Justice and Empowerment / Beneficiary Dashboard (new)

New journey and screen: compact head, then Scholarships and Fellowship, Hostels and Top Class Education, and one Year by Year Trends (segmented button, ranked fund bars, two-panel year-wise cards).

SMILE – Beggary / All India

Compact head (portal name leads, no repeated figures); back link above the filters; Persons Rehabilitated heads Rehabilitation by Type, bars largest first; 26.0% heads the monthly trend; Completed green, Discontinued grey; figures level across Where the Scheme Works.

DAPSC (e-Utthaan) / All India

Compact head; allocation and expenditure in one chart with the 2026-27 note and no empty R.E.; Mandated Allocation reads against the mandate; the standard State/UT select.

Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan / All India

Compact head; the six coverage figures on one line; the standard State/UT select.

SHRESHTA (e-Anudaan) / All India

Compact head with e-Anudaan as the title; no empty half.

Senior Citizens Welfare / All Components

Compact head; PM-SPECIAL, SAGE and Other Initiatives start their cards level.

Officer Login

User ID and password only; the account decides the scope. (A redesign of this screen is proposed separately.)

Dashboard Landing / Signed In as Ministry

As the All India landing, with 'Sign Out' in the officer notice.

Shared Sections

Year on Year Report merged into Year by Year Trends and retired; the three sections renamed Department Page Sections; the slot closed.
